title: Smoke 11 - Diabetes Alert
description: Emits warning card if patient has diabetes condition in prefetch.
cqlContent:
library "Smoke11Diabetes" version '1.0.0'

using FHIR version '4.0.1'

context Patient

define "HasCondition":
  exists([Condition])

define "ConditionCard":
  if "HasCondition" then
    Tuple {
      summary: 'Patient has active condition',
      detail: 'CQL saw a Condition resource in prefetch — conditional card logic confirmed.',
      indicator: 'warning',
      sourceLabel: 'Smoke 11'
    }
  else null
